digest.component_or_area: CLI registry and command dispatch system
propositions: The explicit intercept selection ladder and 13 duplicate literal policy frozensets have been removed from the router, which now derives its four live policy sets from _registry.derive_policy_sets().
Every intercept route and audit command now carries executable metadata (lazy handler, argv adapter, init policy) and dispatches through the single _execute.execute entrypoint.
Both CLI generators (gen_cli_help.py and gen_cli_reference.py) pass --check validation byte-identically on second render, confirming deterministic output.
Per-family subprocess E2E tests confirm behavior preservation across all routing families (reconcile, review-plan, enrich, config, verify-*, identity, audit) with unchanged exit codes and output.
The _cli/__init__.py (340 LOC) and _registry.py (754 LOC) modules remain under the 800-line constraint with no mechanically-split file under 100 lines, and all linting and type checks pass.
